rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with the Google Search Console API to provide 25 tools for search analytics, URL inspection, sitemap management, and CSV export. Extended tools add SEO reporting including quick wins analysis, keyword cannibalization detection, content decay monitoring, and weekly reports. Supports OAuth 2.0 desktop flow and service account authentication with automatic property resolution from bare domain names.
